claims.paraphrase: The OCC distinguishes sale-intended mortgage origination commitments from excluded commitments; eligible commitments use fair-value balances and earnings changes. Notional reporting is separate from pull-through weighting.
claims.exclusions: Origination commitments for mortgage loans intended for sale; fair-value balances, earnings movement, scoped exclusions and notional reconciliation. Exclude hedge accounting, actual valuation model construction, settled originations and source scenarios.

claims.paraphrase: OCC staff guidance describes class-level amortization with impairment or fair-value-through-earnings measurement; the fair-value election is irreversible.
claims.exclusions: Already recognized servicing assets and separately stipulated class elections; distinguish amortization/impairment from fair-value measurement. Exclude initial transfer qualification, interest-only strips, source sale scenario and figures.

claims.paraphrase: Texas distinguishes permanent service-utility loss from reduced utilization; recognized losses are not reversed merely because service utility returns.
claims.exclusions: Permanent service-utility loss versus temporary underutilization; recognized impairment amount will be independently stipulated. Exclude measurement-method derivation, leased-asset details, local thresholds and source examples.

claims.paraphrase: Texas separates recovery from restoration and distinguishes a realized or realizable recovery in the loss year from one recognized later.
claims.exclusions: Ordinary government-wide impairment, realized/realizable recovery, separate restoration transaction and timing comparison. Exclude unusual/infrequent classification, governmental-fund recognition and local codes.

claims.paraphrase: The historical bulletin addresses accrual reporting of nontrust single-employer OPEB, including total liability, expense and deferred resources; measurement-period benefit payments reduce liability.
claims.exclusions: Single-employer defined-benefit nontrust arrangement; supplied actuarial outputs, benefit-payment reduction and deferred-resource reconciliation. Exclude New York trust authority, implementation dates, transition, administrative-expense treatment, actuarial model construction and source appendices.
